approver: User (explicit request to import NOAA Ocean Service articles)
decision: The user explicitly authorized a real NOAA Ocean Service import batch. Each official oceanservice.noaa.gov page was fetched and its full text extracted verbatim, then reviewed individually for reuse rights and provenance: a NOAA author credit and citation date are required, and any copyright, third-party credit, courtesy/licence or restriction notice excludes the item. The official NOS disclaimer is recorded as source-policy evidence. No images or media are reused: imageReference is null for every item.
